messages:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: service=llm-router image=redwood/llm-router:v2.7.2 in ~4m. Planned feature-flag change: llm_region_warmup -> EU 0% -> 5% -> 20% over 2h. Change window 23:30-03:30 UTC. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/3751234567. @lina @joel

lina: holding EU ramp — last staging replay shows p99 tail increase ~20% for EU-only traces. preferring a warmup hook before any EU traffic.

joel: agreed. set EU flag to 0% for canaries and keep US plan live. can we add a per-region startup prefetch + kv-seed?

deploy-bot: Current state: queued. Feature flags default to 0% for canaries unless manually set.

ops-ash: applied pause for EU canaries and set llm_region_warmup[eu]=0%. note saved: "pause - investigate EU p99 tail" :pause_button:

qa-rob: running EU-focused cold-start replay and pod startup traces against v2.7.2. capturing CPU/memory and KV population timing. ETA ~14m.

lina: if QA confirms cold-start lag, plan is: 1) rollout-config tweak: prefetch=2 per replica + kv-seed=12s for EU 2) re-run staging 3) conservative roll: EU 1% -> 5% over 90m with safety gate. else rollback to v2.7.1 and pin EU.

joel: rollback/pin snippet for quick exec:
```
# pin EU region to previous version and abort canary
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-router --region eu --version v2.7.1 --reason "canary eu p99 regression"
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 3751234567 --region eu
```

ops-ash: added release-note draft: "EU canary paused: v2.7.2 warmup tweak pending; US ramp continues. No customer-facing issues." PMs and support paged. :memo:

qa-rob: replay results: 6/200 traces exhibit cold-start token tail with KV population delayed ~9s on EU nodes. attaching minimal trace ids.

joel: looks like new batcher defaults increase initial latency in small-shard EU setups. per-region warmup tweak should mitigate. preparing rollout-config patch now.

lina: also add a safety gate: abort if EU p99 > baseline +10% for 10m during ramp. ops-ash, can you add that to the rollout policy?

ops-ash: safety gate added: EU p99 gate (baseline+10%, 10m). EU canary remains paused. ticket annotated and stakeholders notified. :white_check_mark:

joel: pushed rollout-config override for EU: prefetch=2, kv-seed=12s, warmup-probe=true. will run a quick staging replay after patch.

qa-rob: re-run done — cold-start spikes reduced to baseline +/-3%. recommend proceeding with conservative EU ramp.

lina: ok to resume EU manual ramp. manual resume steps: 1) set llm_region_warmup[eu]=1% 2) observe 15m 3) increment to 5% over 75m. keep rollback commands at hand.

ops-ash: manual resume initiated by ops-ash: llm_region_warmup[eu]=1% for canaries. monitoring dashboards pinned to EU p99 by route. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Resume recorded. Canary EU cohort progressing: 1% -> scheduled increments. Automation paused for manual approval steps.

pm-kate: posting short note for PMs: "EU canary resumed with warmup override; conservative ramp and EU p99 safety gate in place. Support on standby."

lina: monitoring first 15m: EU p99 stable at +2% vs baseline, no error-rate change. will wait full 15m then advance if clear.

qa-rob: after 15m, metrics look stable. next step: increase to 5% and watch for 30m.

joel: advancing to 5% now per plan. ops-ash please keep the gate active and be ready to execute pin if it trips.

ops-ash: flag set to 5% for EU. safety gate live. ready to run rollback snippet if needed.

lina: thanks team. thread will remain open until we hit 20% or execute rollback. post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
